missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Диван' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'стоит'. 'Большой' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'в гостиной' locates it. A clean model for describing furniture.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Диван' is inanimate masculine, so the accusative matches the nominative form. 'Новый' agrees with it, and 'купили' takes it as the direct object. Useful for shopping talk.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Дивана' takes the genitive after 'нет' to express that something is lacking. 'Нового' agrees in the masculine genitive. A core negation pattern.

missions.phrase: Я весь день сижу на диване.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'На диване' uses the prepositional form 'диване' after 'на' to mark location. 'Весь день' adds duration. The standard way to say where you are sitting.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'К дивану' uses the dative form 'дивану' after 'к' to show motion toward something. The imperative 'подойди' makes this a natural command.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of location. 'За диваном' uses the instrumental form 'диваном' after 'за' to mean behind something. A common way to describe a hidden spot.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Диванов' is the genitive plural after 'много'. 'Дешёвых' agrees in the genitive plural. A useful quantity pattern for shopping.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Диваны' is the nominative plural subject. 'Эти' and 'удобные' agree in the plural, and 'очень' intensifies. Good for comparing several items.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of location. 'Под диваном' uses the instrumental form after 'под' to mean underneath. 'Лежит' describes the resting position. Practical for describing a room.

Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Диван' is nominative as the subject. 'Этот' points at a specific one and 'мягкий' is the agreeing masculine adjective, reinforced by 'слишком'. A clean descriptive card.
